verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The rewriting is the substitution l = chartScale n = Q^{-1/2}, u = Q^{-a}. physicalCompact_pull states the identity for an arbitrary radial scale l, chart map C and amplitude u (so it is more general than r = √Q R, f_* = Q^a f_phys), with the transport directions tied by M • C v = (N * l^d) • w — the Lean form of the paper's M = Λ_g^{i_0}Q^{d_r/2} bookkeeping, supplied by MeanChartCompatibility.radialFrequency_shift (NavierStokes/MeanChartCompatibility.lean:713). The constant u/l is the display's Q^{a-1/2}: fieldOnPhysical encodes f_phys = Q^{-a}(f_* ∘ physicalToChart) with physicalToChart scaling the radius by Q^{-1/2}, i.e. r = √Q R and f_* = Q^a f_phys, and pressure_unit_factor is exactly Q^{-a}/Q^{-1/2} = Q^{-(a-1/2)}; physicalPressure_naturality is the instance at the paper's actual scaling degrees (a = 2A(h) + 1/2 for the source, a - 1/2 = 2A(h) for its compact primitive). The e-range caveat is the same one recorded under eq-8.6 and is not repeated in this severity: for the cutoff-compactified operator the transfer law is stated at e = 0 (physicalCompact_pull, physicalPressure_naturality) and e = 1 (streamPotential_pull), while the general-e version of the same u/l law holds for the signed-stress primitive (physicalSigma_scaled_fiber).
